issue_request: FHIR-5249 is a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 SD technical correction for the Composition CDA-aware readers note in section 6.9.2.2. It asked to correct the sentence beginning "May uesrs of this specification are familiar with the Clinical Document Architecture" to begin "Many users of this specification are familiar with the Clinical Document Architecture".
initial_application: The requested typo appears to have been applied before this reconciliation by SVN-imported commit ba635f13cb87dff61738ee16387eda09ef44f5e5, "$5399 - fix typo"/svn revision 4398, which changed the same sentence in source/composition/composition-introduction.xml from "May uesrs" to "Many users". The historical commit cites the neighboring same-change-family tracker FHIR-5399 rather than FHIR-5249, and FHIR-5249's Jira comments record "already fixed".
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists composition=Composition as an active resource, so source/composition/composition-introduction.xml is build-scoped source. The current Composition introduction still says "Many users of this specification are familiar with the Clinical Document Architecture" and no "May uesrs" or "May users" variant remains in the Composition source. FHIR-5399 is a Published/Persuasive ballot typo tracker for the same sentence and explains why the implementation commit referenced 5399. Zulip and Confluence searches for FHIR-5249 and the CDA sentence found no directly relevant or conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The authoritative current FHIR source already contains the exact correction requested by FHIR-5249, and the active build configuration includes the Composition source where the correction lives.
